sources.title: GitHub - salesforce/ALBEF: Code for ALBEF: a new vision-language pre ...
sources.snippet: This is the official PyTorch implementation of the ALBEF paper [Blog]. This repository supports pre-training on custom datasets, as well as finetuning on VQA, SNLI-VE, NLVR2, Image-Text Retrieval on MSCOCO and Flickr30k, and visual grounding on RefCOCO+. Pre-trained and finetuned checkpoints are released.
